story.ch03.title: A Foundation That Listens
story.ch03.summary: The Foundation trial teaches the apprentice to follow readable flow rather than resist every pulse. Power becomes a way to investigate safely, not proof that the system is right.
story.ch03.s01.title: The Bowl and the Crack
story.ch03.s01.line_01: Hold this bowl under the stream. Not the cracked side. See how the flow changes before it rises?
story.ch03.s01.line_02: If I force it still, the rim takes all the strain.
story.ch03.s01.line_03: Your Foundation is not a stone you put over a leak. It is a place to stand while the flow moves. Watch, give it room, then act.
story.ch03.s01.line_04: Does passing the trial mean the array accepts me?
story.ch03.s01.line_05: It means your body can carry more without breaking. The array can test that. It cannot tell you whether its own work is fair.
story.ch03.s01.line_06: Then I will use the strength to reach the places we have not checked.
story.ch03.s01.objective: Complete the three Qi Refining ranks, then enter the Foundation trial.
story.ch03.s01.journal: Foundation Establishment increases what my body can withstand. It is not approval of the array’s purpose. The trial requires the three Qi Refining ranks and Bamboo Guardian proof; entry costs nothing.
story.ch03.s01.requirements: Foundation trial: complete all three Qi Refining ranks and defeat the Bamboo Guardian. Entry is free.
story.ch03.s01.bowl: The bowl has been mended twice. Water can be caught without pretending the crack is gone.
story.ch03.s02.title: Read the Space Between Strikes
story.ch03.s02.line_01: FOUNDATION TEST. Read the marked strike area. Survive three waves. Disable the defense construct.
story.ch03.s02.line_02: A marked place to strike, and room beside it. I do not have to fight the whole sky.
story.ch03.s02.line_03: The first light travels before the thunder. Move with the warning, not the noise.
story.ch03.s02.line_04: The second wave changes its spacing. The ground still tells me where to stand.
story.ch03.s02.line_05: The last pulse leaves a gap. Keep my breath for the frame that follows.
story.ch03.s02.line_06: Now the frame. Watch its hands, then answer.
story.ch03.s02.line_07: The pressure is still here. It has room to pass through me.
story.ch03.s02.objective: Survive three lightning waves and defeat the final construct.
story.ch03.s02.journal: I passed the Foundation trial by following readable warnings and leaving room for the flow. Foundation rewards are saved. The trial proved endurance, not the wisdom of the mountain’s system.
story.ch03.s02.failure: Foundation attempt failed. Cultivation, notes, and banked materials are retained. Retry from the arena entrance.
story.ch03.s02.retry: The outline comes before the flash. There is time to read it.
story.ch03.s02.repeat: Foundation is already established. This is a training replay; no second breakthrough reward will be granted.
story.ch03.s03.title: Strength with an Unanswered Question
story.ch03.s03.line_01: Your hand no longer shakes when the return line pulses. How does it feel?
story.ch03.s03.line_02: Heavier, but not trapped. I can feel where the pressure wants to go.
story.ch03.s03.line_03: Good. The basin has water again. Do not let that small success answer the question about the voice.
story.ch03.s03.line_04: It asked me to hold the second anchor. I will inspect Ashen Peak before reconnecting anything.
story.ch03.s03.line_05: The release anchor keeps its service records beside the heat vents. If there is a reason the pressure cannot leave, start with what the workers wrote.
story.ch03.s03.line_06: Bring the old pressure sheets. I want the first number beside the latest one.
story.ch03.s03.objective: Prepare at the sanctuary, then inspect the Ashen Peak release records.
story.ch03.s03.journal: Foundation is established. The basin has water again, but the governor’s voice and raised pressure remain unresolved. Ashen Peak is now accessible for inspection; the release records may explain where the load is meant to go.
story.ch03.s03.choice_VOICE: I want to know who asked me to stop.
story.ch03.s03.response_VOICE: Then do not turn his words into an omen. Find a name, a duty, something a person had to live with.
story.ch03.s03.choice_SYSTEM: I want to know what the release was built to do.
story.ch03.s03.response_SYSTEM: Read the service record beside the design. Things that work on paper still need someone to tend them.
